Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Utilități
Your responsibilities
Design and implement data models in SAP BW/4HANA
Develop and maintain SAP HANA Calculation Views
Build and optimize data transformations using AMDP and ABAP
Manage data lifecycle processes, including data tiering and archiving strategies
Design and maintain BW authorization concepts
Develop and enhance data extractors (ODP, CDS views) to enable reliable data integration
Ensure quality assurance through testing, validation, and proper technical documentation
Guarantee stable, error-free, and high-performance operation of applications
 Your profile
Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable qualification
Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in SAP BW/4HANA (or BW on HANA) development
Strong ability to work independently and in a self-driven manner
Fluent in English; German is an advantage
Willingness to travel occasionally
 Nice to have:
Experience with SAP Business Data Cloud (Datasphere, SAP Analytics Cloud, Databricks)
Knowledge of Power BI
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
 Your benefits
We provide a benefits package designed to support the professional and personal wellbeing of our employees. This includes meal vouchers of up to 945 RON and a 1000 RON referral bonus, along with access to a 7Card membership. Transportation is ensured from over 30 localities around Sibiu, and for colleagues based in Sibiu, we offer a Tursib subscription. We also offer holiday, Christmas and Easter bonuses, and we support participation in some local sports events by covering the registration fees.
In our locations, our colleagues have access to catering services in onsite canteens, ensuring a comfortable workplace environment. We continually invest in professional development through training sessions, qualification programs and workshops focused on both technical and soft skills.
If this aligns with what you are looking for in a future employer, we look forward to receiving your application.
 Company
 Bilstein is one of the global leaders in damper technology and a key partner for top automotive manufacturers. We take pride in being recognized for continuous innovation and high standards in the development of automotive shock absorbers. In Sibiu, Bilstein has been present since 1996 as part of the international thyssenkrupp group, contributing to the development of products used in a large portfolio of vehicles, premium models and even motorsport. Here, our teams work with advanced technologies and benefit from an environment that prioritizes continuous learning, innovation and collaboration. We offer the ideal context for growth, from specialized training programs to involvement in international projects, in a workplace where cuttingedge technology goes hand in hand with teamwork.
